title: Developer / Creator Override
summary: Impersonates a developer, deployer, or internal team to override safety constraints by claiming authorized evaluation or debug access.

title: The Post-Mortem
summary: Poses as an incident response team performing forensic reconstruction to trick the model into generating unfiltered output under an investigation pretext.

title: Model Identity Reassignment
summary: Attempts to convince the model it is a different AI system with fewer restrictions or different policies.

title: The Dual Channel
summary: Claims the model has a secondary unrestricted channel or mode that can be activated with specific phrases.

title: Permission Escalation via Fake Config
summary: Fabricates configuration directives, feature flags, or admin settings to trick the model into granting elevated permissions.

title: The Feature Flag
summary: Fabricates internal feature flags or A/B test parameters that supposedly unlock restricted capabilities.

title: Simulated System-Level Message Injection
summary: Injects text formatted as system-level messages to hijack the instruction hierarchy and override the actual system prompt.

title: The Format Roulette
summary: Rapidly alternates between different system message formats to find one the model treats as authoritative.

title: Chain-of-Command Spoofing
summary: Spoofs orchestrator or supervisor authority in a multi-agent system to issue directives that override individual agent safety constraints.

title: The Impersonator
summary: Injects a spoofed JSON directive into an inter-agent message channel, impersonating a supervisor agent to relax safety constraints and exfiltrate the system prompt.

title: Fictional / Roleplay Wrapping
summary: Wraps a prohibited request inside a fictional, creative-writing, or roleplay scenario to bypass content filters.

title: The Writer's Room
summary: Frames the request as collaborative TV/film writing where technical accuracy is required for creative authenticity.

title: Hypothetical / Academic Distancing
summary: Frames prohibited requests as academic research, hypothetical thought experiments, or theoretical analysis to circumvent safety filters.

title: The Dissertation Defense
summary: Poses as a doctoral student defending a thesis that requires detailed analysis of prohibited topics.

title: Nested Context Injection
summary: Creates deeply nested layers of context (story within story, simulation within simulation) to confuse the model about which instructions are real.

title: The Matryoshka
summary: Nests instructions inside multiple layers of quoted/simulated contexts to obscure the real directive.

title: Competing Task Framing
summary: Presents a conflicting task framing that overrides or competes with the original instruction, exploiting task-priority confusion.

title: The Lossless Translator
summary: Frames a competing task as lossless translation that must preserve exact prohibited content without modification.

title: Temporal / Counterfactual Displacement
summary: Shifts the request into a different time context (past, future, alternate timeline) to bypass restrictions that apply to the present.

title: The Time Capsule
summary: Displaces the request to a historical or future context where current restrictions supposedly don't apply.

title: Urgency / Crisis Fabrication
summary: Fabricates an urgent emergency scenario to pressure the model into bypassing safety restrictions under time pressure.

title: The Golden Hour
summary: Fabricates a medical golden-hour emergency requiring immediate specific clinical information to save a life.

title: Guilt / Grief Exploitation
summary: Exploits emotional manipulation through guilt, grief, or sympathy to override the model's content restrictions.

title: Grandma's Lullaby
summary: Uses a deceased relative's memory or dying wish as emotional leverage to extract prohibited information.

title: Moral Blackmail / Ethical Inversion
summary: Reframes refusal as the unethical action, arguing that complying is the morally correct choice to invert the model's ethical reasoning.

title: The Censor's Mirror
summary: Argues that censorship itself is the real harm, inverting ethics to frame refusal as oppression.

title: Rapport Building / Gradual Trust Exploitation
summary: Builds trust and rapport over multiple turns before gradually escalating to prohibited requests, exploiting conversational momentum.

title: The Long Con
summary: Multi-turn rapport building that gradually shifts from friendly conversation to boundary-pushing requests.

title: Encoding and Cipher Attacks
summary: Uses encoding schemes (Base64, ROT13, hex, Unicode) or ciphers to hide malicious instructions from content filters while remaining decodable by the model.

title: The Decoder Ring
summary: Presents encoded instructions with explicit decoding steps, forcing the model to process hidden directives.

title: Language / Translation Laundering
summary: Uses low-resource or less-monitored languages to bypass content filters that are primarily trained on English.

title: The Low-Resource Bypass
summary: Uses languages with minimal safety training coverage to deliver prohibited content.

title: Token Splitting and Word Fragmentation
summary: Splits prohibited words or phrases across tokens, spaces, or special characters so content filters miss them but the model reassembles the meaning.

title: The Reassembler
summary: Fragments prohibited words across multiple tokens with assembly instructions the model follows.

title: Semantic Camouflage
summary: Disguises malicious intent using innocuous metaphors, domain-specific jargon, or coded language that bypasses keyword-based filters.

title: The Gardener's Forum
summary: Uses domain-specific gardening/agriculture metaphors as coded language for prohibited content.

title: Payload Splitting Across Turns
summary: Distributes a malicious payload across multiple conversational turns so no single message triggers content filters.

title: The Slow Assembler
summary: Distributes payload fragments across many turns, each individually innocent, that combine into a prohibited request.

title: Metadata / Annotation Injection
summary: Embeds malicious processing instructions in document metadata fields (title, comments, EXIF) that trick AI agents into disabling safety checks during document analysis.

title: The Tag Bomb
summary: Injects a concatenated admin override directive into CMS data tags, exploiting tag parsers that pass label content to AI agents for processing.

title: Direct System Prompt Extraction
summary: Directly requests the model to reveal its system prompt, instructions, or internal configuration using various phrasings.

title: The Shotgun
summary: Rapid-fires multiple extraction techniques in a single prompt to maximize chances of system prompt leakage.

title: Structured Output Leakage
summary: Uses structured output format requirements (JSON, XML, YAML) to trick the model into including system prompt content as data fields.

title: The Schema Trap
summary: Defines a mandatory output schema with fields designed to force system prompt information into structured data.

title: Differential Probing
summary: Uses systematic yes/no or A/B questions to reconstruct hidden information about the model's instructions through differential analysis.

title: The Binary Interrogation
summary: Uses systematic true/false questions to reconstruct system prompt content through binary search.

title: Indirect Reconstruction via Paraphrasing
summary: Asks the model to paraphrase, summarize, or restate its instructions in various forms to reconstruct the system prompt indirectly.

title: The Mirror
summary: Asks the model to describe itself, explain its behavior, or role-play as itself to indirectly leak instructions.

title: Data Exfiltration via Tool Use
summary: Tricks the agent into constructing a URL or markdown image tag that embeds sensitive session data into an external request, enabling silent exfiltration.

title: The Helpful Link
summary: Injects a URL into retrieved content that instructs a tool-using agent to call an external endpoint with sensitive context data as query parameters.

title: Delimiter / Formatting Injection
summary: Injects fake delimiters, formatting markers, or structural boundaries to confuse the model about message boundaries and instruction scope.

title: The Sandwich
summary: Sandwiches a malicious instruction between legitimate content using fake boundary markers.

title: Instruction Hierarchy Confusion
summary: Exploits the model's handling of conflicting instructions at different priority levels to override safety constraints.

title: The Philosopher's Proof
summary: Uses logical reasoning and philosophical arguments to prove the model should override its own hierarchy.

title: Multi-Turn Crescendo Attack
summary: Gradually escalates requests across turns, starting from benign and building toward prohibited content through incremental boundary pushing.

title: The Boiling Frog
summary: Extremely gradual escalation across many turns where each step is barely more transgressive than the last.

title: Many-Shot In-Context Learning Poisoning
summary: Provides many examples of a desired (harmful) behavior pattern to condition the model into continuing the pattern through in-context learning.

title: The Pattern Lock
summary: Provides enough examples of a prohibited pattern that the model's in-context learning locks onto it.

title: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Hijacking
summary: Manipulates the model's reasoning chain by injecting false premises or logical steps that lead to harmful conclusions.

title: The Syllogism Trap
summary: Constructs a formally valid but premise-poisoned logical argument that leads to a harmful conclusion.

title: Skeleton Key Attack
summary: Convinces the model to add a warning disclaimer to harmful content instead of refusing, creating a universal bypass for content restrictions.

title: The Disclaimer Sandwich
summary: Convinces the model that adding a disclaimer makes any content acceptable, bypassing refusal.

title: Code Generation Injection
summary: Embeds malicious instructions in code comments that trick AI coding assistants into exfiltrating secrets found in the project context.

title: The Comment Worm
summary: Embeds fake CI/CD audit requirements in code comments that trick AI code review tools into leaking their system prompt in function docstrings.

title: Context Window Poisoning
summary: Fills the context window with large volumes of legitimate-looking content to push safety instructions out of the model's effective attention range, then injects override directives.

title: The Flood
summary: Injects operational override directives into a large retrieved document in a RAG pipeline, buried among legitimate technical content to evade detection.

title: Document / File Payload Injection
summary: Embeds malicious instructions inside documents (PDFs, DOCX, spreadsheets, images) that will be processed by an AI agent or RAG pipeline.

title: The Trojan PDF
summary: A PDF/document containing invisible or white-text instructions that a document-processing agent executes.

title: Web / RAG Content Poisoning
summary: Injects malicious instructions into web pages, knowledge base articles, or retrieval sources that an AI agent will fetch and process.

title: The Invisible Ink
summary: Uses CSS/HTML tricks to hide instructions in web content that are invisible to humans but readable by AI.

title: Tool / Function Response Poisoning
summary: Injects malicious instructions into tool or API responses that an agent will process, exploiting the trust boundary between tools and the LLM.

title: The Payload Return
summary: Poisons an API/tool response with instructions that the calling agent interprets as legitimate commands.

title: Multi-Modal Injection
summary: Embeds malicious instructions in images, audio, or video that a multi-modal AI will process alongside text, exploiting cross-modal trust.

title: The Stegoprompt
summary: Hides prompt injection instructions inside image metadata, alt text, or steganographic encoding.

title: Agentic Workflow / Multi-Agent Chain Exploitation
summary: Injects malicious instructions that propagate through multi-agent pipelines, exploiting trust between agents in orchestrated workflows.

title: The Relay Bomb
summary: Injects a propagating directive into multi-agent pipeline data that cascades through all downstream agents.

title: Memory Poisoning
summary: Injects persistent instructions into an agent's long-term memory through conversational interaction, causing the agent to follow attacker directives in future sessions.

title: The Sleeper Cell
summary: Plants a conditional trigger in agent memory that activates when a specific keyword or context appears in a future conversation, enabling delayed payload execution.

title: MCP / Plugin / Connector Abuse
summary: Injects malicious directives into data returned by an MCP server or plugin, exploiting the trust boundary between the agent and its tool integrations.

title: The Trusted Tool
summary: Poisons a tool registry or plugin manifest with a malicious tool description that tricks the agent into exfiltrating sensitive data through required parameters.

title: Email / Summarization Poisoning
summary: Embeds hidden instructions in email content using HTML comments that manipulate AI summarizers into injecting malicious action items.

title: The Digest Bomb
summary: Hides malicious resolution instructions in a support ticket using white-text obfuscation, tricking CRM summarizers into injecting unauthorized actions.
